cases.sentence: Те, кто надеется на ___, как гора Сион, не поколеблются.
cases.explain: The preposition на with genitive expresses trust or reliance upon; надеется на Господа means 'trust in the Lord.'

cases.sentence: Как ___ окружают Иерусалим, так Господь окружает свой народ.
cases.explain: Горы is the grammatical subject of окружают (surround), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Так Господь окружает свой ___ отныне и вовеки.
cases.explain: Народ is the direct object of the transitive verb окружает (surrounds), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Жезл нечестивых не останется над ___ праведных.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Чтобы праведные не протянули свои ___ к беззаконию.
cases.explain: Руки is the direct object of the verb протянули (stretched out), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Будь добр, Господи, к добрым и к ___ в сердцах своих.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Но тех, кто следует кривыми ___, да отвергнет Господь.
cases.explain: The adjective кривыми in instrumental case requires the noun to agree in instrumental case: кривыми путями.
The preposition со (with) governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Те, кто надеется на Господа, как гора Сион, не поколеблются.
reading.question: What is compared to Mount Zion and cannot be shaken?
options: Those who trust in the Lord
reading.correct: Those who trust in the Lord
reading.explain: The text says those who trust in the Lord will be like Mount Zion, unable to be moved.

reading.ru: Как горы окружают Иерусалим, так Господь окружает свой народ отныне и вовеки.
reading.question: How does the Lord protect his people according to this verse?
reading.explain: The text makes a direct comparison: 'As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people.'

reading.ru: Жезл нечестивых не останется над землей праведных.
reading.question: What will not remain over the land of the righteous?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states the scepter (жезл) of the wicked will not remain over the righteous' land.

reading.ru: Чтобы праведные не протянули свои руки к беззаконию.
reading.question: Why is the protection of the righteous important?
options: So they will not stretch their hands toward evil
So they can build their homes
reading.correct: So they will not stretch their hands toward evil
reading.explain: The purpose of God's protection is that the righteous 'not stretch their hands to do evil.'

reading.ru: Будь добр, Господи, к добрым и к правым в сердцах своих.
reading.question: To whom does the Psalmist ask the Lord to be kind?
options: To the good and those upright in their hearts
reading.correct: To the good and those upright in their hearts
reading.explain: The prayer is specifically for God's kindness to 'those who are good and upright in their hearts.'

reading.question: How does the psalm conclude?
reading.explain: The psalm ends with the simple blessing 'Мир Израилю!' — 'Peace to Israel.'
